options_en: The High Court must quash the order whenever an appeal is available.
The High Court loses all writ jurisdiction once a statutory appeal exists.
The High Court may entertain the petition for breach of natural justice despite the appeal; relief is not automatic.
Only Parliament can permit a writ petition after a statutory appeal has been provided.
